title: Knight Vision
cn: 第 6 集 · 骑士幻想
novel:
Ted had three [[prospects|prospect]] for a date to the wedding. Lily and Marshall tried to help him [[choose|choose]] the best one. They warned him to use good [[judgment|judgment]] and not pick someone [[poorly|poorly]].

Ted, however, [[ignored|ignore]] their advice and chose the woman who seemed the most exciting. This turned out to be a terrible [[mistake|mistake]]. The date was [[awkward|awkward]] from the start, and Ted immediately [[regretted|regret]] his choice.

Meanwhile, Barney and Robin had to [[confront|confront]] their wedding minister. The minister did not approve of their lifestyle and made them feel uncomfortable. Robin was [[upset|upset]] and wanted to find a new minister, but there was very little time before the ceremony.

Barney tried to [[convince|convince]] the minister that they were a good couple. He shared stories about how they met and fell in love. The minister was [[stubborn|stubborn]] at first, but eventually softened after hearing their story.

Marshall [[learned|learn]] more about Daphne during their car ride. He discovered that she was not as [[annoying|annoying]] as he first thought. She was going through a difficult time and just needed someone to talk to. Marshall felt [[sympathetic|sympathetic]] toward her.

Ted's date ended in [[disaster|disaster]] when the woman revealed she was already engaged to someone else. Ted went back to his friends and [[admitted|admit]] he should have listened to them. They all laughed about it later.

Robin and Barney managed to keep their minister after promising to [[behave|behave]] during the ceremony. The day ended with mixed results, but the group stayed [[optimistic|optimistic]] about the wedding.

prospect.en: She is a good prospect for the job.

poorly.en: He performed poorly on the test.

upset.en: He was upset about the news.

convince.en: She convinced him to try again.

sympathetic.en: She was sympathetic to his problem.

optimistic.en: She stayed optimistic about the future.
